Every credential here comes from the provider secret store at deploy time
(10.1.1-T2/T3) and is distinct from staging's — no credential and no network

description: Pilot production environment: its own provider account, database with backup/PITR (10.5.1) and bucket, behind a load balancer with ≥ 2 Evidgate.Api replicas and ≥ 1 Evidgate.Worker replica (FR-10-1). Provider, region and the exact replica counts are [OPEN] pending 10.8.1 (O3); the counts are the floor the area plan requires, not a measured sizing.

EVIDGATE__DATABASE__CONNECTIONSTRING.from: provider secret store (10.1.1-T3), injected as an environment variable at deploy; Username=evidgate_app, prod's own managed PostgreSQL 18 host with PITR — no path or credential is shared with staging (AC4)

EVIDGATE__ISOLATION__SELFCHECK.from: not set: the option default Required applies, so a prod boot that cannot confirm tenant isolation refuses to start (00 §5.4, 02.6.1-T1.4). Setting Disabled in prod is forbidden

EVIDGATE__TASKS__QUEUEROUTES__<n>__QUEUE.from: empty route list until 10.2.2 routes a task type

EVIDGATE__TASKS__QUEUEROUTES__<n>__TASKT.from: empty route list until 10.2.2 routes a task type

EVIDGATE__TASKS__QUEUES__<n>__CONCURRENC.from: empty queue list; the schedule-declared queues are consumed at DefaultQueueConcurrency

EVIDGATE__TASKS__QUEUES__<n>__NAME.from: empty queue list; the schedule-declared queues are consumed at DefaultQueueConcurrency

EVIDGATE__TASKS__SWEEPCONNECTIONSTRING.from: provider secret store: the prod-only evidgate_worker_sched credential for the owner SECURITY DEFINER sweeps (TL T80). The sweep role's credential is per environment like every other one

EVIDGATE__TELEMETRY__OTLPENDPOINT.from: the prod collector endpoint injected at deploy (10.3.1-T2). Required: alerts (FR-10-6) and the SLIs (FR-10-7) are measured from it, and 00 §11 forbids a secret in a log field or metric label. Backend and endpoint are [OPEN]

EVIDGATE__WORKER__HEALTHADDRESS.from: not set: the listener binds 0.0.0.0 inside the instance, as in staging — reachable on the internal path the probe uses, never publicly, because only /v1/* is forwarded (00 §9.1). ⚠️ settled with 10.2.1-T1's image and edge configuration

EVIDGATE__WORKER__HEALTHPORT.from: not set: the Worker's internal health listener uses 8081, which is what probes.worker.baseUrl below addresses

EVIDGATE_APP_PASSWORD.from: dev-stack only (scripts/dev/up.sh placeholder): prod holds the evidgate_app credential in the provider secret store, referenced by EVIDGATE__DATABASE__CONNECTIONSTRING

EVIDGATE_DB_PORT.from: dev-stack only (compose loopback port); prod reaches its database through the provider network

EVIDGATE_DB_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD.from: dev-stack only; no human or script holds a prod superuser password — prod's bootstrap runs once under the deploy identity (10.1.1-T3, area plan §6)

EVIDGATE_MIGRATOR__COMMANDTIMEOUTSECONDS.from: option default 0 (no statement timeout), so a long index build is not cut in half; the deploy gate bounds the run (10.2.2-T1)

EVIDGATE_MIGRATOR__CONNECTIONSTRING.from: provider secret store: the prod evidgate_owner credential, used only by the migration job (10.2.2-T1) and never by Api or Worker (00 §5.4.3); migrations never run against prod from a developer machine (area plan §6)

EVIDGATE_MIGRATOR__MIGRATIONSPATH.from: not set: ⚠️ what the Evidgate.Migrator image ships is settled in 10.2.1-T1; until then the process resolves <application directory>/migrations

EVIDGATE_OPERATOR_PASSWORD.from: dev-stack only; the prod evidgate_operator credential is rotated with the other keys (10.7.1-T4) and only ever used through an audited support grant (00 §2 platform_operator)

EVIDGATE_OWNER_PASSWORD.from: dev-stack only: prod holds the same role's password in the provider secret store, referenced by EVIDGATE_MIGRATOR__CONNECTIONSTRING

EVIDGATE_S3_ACCESS_KEY.from: dev-stack only (local SeaweedFS identity); the runtime object-storage options and their prod credentials arrive with 06.3.1 and 10.1.1-T3

EVIDGATE_S3_BUCKET.from: dev-stack only; the prod bucket with versioning and lifecycle is provisioned by 10.1.1-T3 and 10.5.1-T2

EVIDGATE_S3_ENDPOINT.from: dev-stack only; the prod S3-compatible endpoint is [OPEN] until O3

EVIDGATE_S3_REGION.from: dev-stack only; the provider region is [OPEN] until O3 and is a residency criterion for plan 11

EVIDGATE_S3_SECRET_KEY.from: dev-stack only (local SeaweedFS identity); prod's key lives in the provider secret store

EVIDGATE_SEAWEEDFS_S3_CONFIG.from: dev-stack only: the committed local identity is accepted by the local container and by nothing else

EVIDGATE_WORKER_SCHED_PASSWORD.from: dev-stack only; prod holds the same role's password in the provider secret store, referenced by EVIDGATE__TASKS__SWEEPCONNECTIONSTRING

api.baseUrlNote: the probe runs on the instance (container/sidecar) next to the Api and addresses the loopback port; ⚠️ the image's listen port and the probe's execution location are settled in 10.2.1-T1

worker.baseUrlNote: EVIDGATE__WORKER__HEALTHPORT default 8081, addressed from inside the instance

ingress.note: The load balancer forwards only /v1/* to Evidgate.Api; /internal/* and /metrics are reachable only on the internal path, and /internal/operator/* only on the operator ingress with an audited support grant (00 §9.1, TL T16). 10.2.2-T1 verifies readiness through the internal path before it promotes a release. The rule is provider-neutral: the edge/load-balancer configuration that enforces these path lists is 10.2.1-T1's.
